title: Tarique Rahman spent 17 years in exile. He is now poised to lead Bangladesh
note: Associated Press report published after the 12 February 2026 vote, describing local-media and party claims that the BNP had secured a parliamentary majority and framing the election's immediate political outcome.
whyItMatters: Useful for the immediate post-election outcome phase, especially the widely reported claim that the BNP emerged as the leading parliamentary force after the vote.
